customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be a top-tier security solution with impressive build quality and features that are useful for the whole family. They appreciate its user-friendly app, clean appearance that looks like a simple door handle, and consider it worth the money. Installation takes time according to some customers.

reviews.author: Tamal Ghosh
reviews.title: Not flawless
reviews.body: This product is good but it has a major design flaw. None of my guests able to open the door when they leave the home. I always have to open the door if the visitor is new. Opening door from the inside is non intuitive, hidden behind the handle and very confusing. Nobody still today able to open the door in the first time without asking us to open the door for them. I think I have been using it for 3 months now and still finding a smart one who can open the door in first trial. May be I sound like too dramatic and making it a big deal on small issue. reviews.title: Good product
reviews.body: I’m pleased with the Urban Company Native Lock. It feels secure, the controls are easy to use, and its features are useful for the whole family. The camera could use some improvement, but overall it has been a good experience. A special thank-you to Aakruti for following up, checking that the functions were working properly, and making sure we were comfortable using the lock. I appreciate her attentive service and she bought me to give this review looks good

reviews.author: Rachna
reviews.title: Very happy with the purchase
reviews.body: Best in the lock category.. really happy with the security of the lock and after sale service by Urban Clap. Go ahead and buy… its one time investment ✨

reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: Great Look and Excellent Features
reviews.body: Very happy with my purchase! The mocha finish matches perfectly with our main door, and the lock has some great features that make it convenient and easy to use. Overall, very satisfied with the product.

reviews.author: shivaditya
reviews.title: Solid smart lock — exactly what I needed
reviews.body: Solid smart lock — exactly what I needed Bought the Native Lock Ultra about three weeks ago and I'm genuinely impressed. The build quality feels premium; heavy-duty and solid, nothing like the flimsy locks I've tried before. The auto-lock feature is my favourite — I no longer have to second-guess whether I locked the door before leaving. The app connectivity is smooth and the fingerprint sensor responds quickly. Battery life seems excellent so far, with no signs of draining fast. The keypad backlight is a nice touch for night use. Overall, great value for the price.
